Evan: Quick heads-up — brought up hf/llamax-1.2 through redwood-convert and quant pipeline.
Evan: Seeing token-count deltas vs HF tokenizer and chat prefix collapse in streaming mode :eyes:
Priya: Can you paste the convert command and the tokenizer snippet?
Evan: Sure, here's what I ran:
```
python -m redwood.tools.convert_hf --model hf/llamax-1.2 --out /tmp/llama_redwood --tokenizer --force
```
Evan: tokenizer_config from HF repo (as converted):
```
{'normalizer': 'NFKC', 'pretokenizer': 'byte_fallback', 'add_prefix_space': false, 'unknown_token': '<unk>'}
```
Liam: add_prefix_space=false is suspicious for chat-mode. HF chat wrappers often rely on leading space handling. try add_prefix_space=true
Evan: I tried that — counts changed:
```
NFKC + add_prefix_space=false -> tokens: 121
NFKC + add_prefix_space=true  -> tokens: 123
NONE  + add_prefix_space=true  -> tokens: 120
```
Evan: The model's generation shifts: prompts with leading quotes end up missing the first token sometimes (off-by-one) when prefix_space=false. Seen in streaming and kv-cache traces.
Priya: Also check unicode normalization: NFKC vs NFD cause combining marks to attach differently -> token boundary shift.
EvalBot: Quick perf eval on 200 prompts (beam=1):
```
baseline (HF tokenizer): exact_match=0.672
converted (NFKC, add_prefix_space=false): exact_match=0.654
converted (NFKC, add_prefix_space=true) : exact_match=0.667
```
Evan: Interesting: enabling add_prefix_space recovers most of the drop. But we still see subtle tokenization differences on emojis and zero-width joiners.
Liam: Could be byte_fallback ordering too. HF's byte fallback runs before normalization in some tokenizers. We should mirror their pretokenizer order exactly.
Priya: Can you run a small diff on tokenizer.encode(p) across a curated prompt set (quotes, emoji, combining marks, leading spaces) and attach a script output?
Evan: Will do. Also running a quick int8 quant experiment — noticed ~1.5% extra regression post-quant, but I suspect tokenization mismatch amplifies eval noise.
Priya: Good call. If tokenization mismatch explains >=1% we should fix that first.
InfraBot: conversion-job-987 completed (duration 00:21:12) :white_check_mark:
Evan: Uploading diff and a minimal repro in ~10m. tagging @Liam @Priya
Evan: TL;DR: match HF normalizer + pretokenizer ordering and enable add_prefix_space for chat-mode to avoid prefix collapse; rerun quant eval after.
